name: simcoe-walker-standing
js: (async()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,d=C.WATERFRONT_WAVEDECKS.find(d=>d.id==='simcoe'),x=-526,z=586,h=C.waterfrontDeckSurfaceHeight(d,x,z);if(!C.waterfrontPublicRealmEnabled)throw Error('wavedecks disabled');a.selectMode('person');a.controllerManager.teleportActiveTo(x,z,1.57,h);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));const p=a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity().position;if(Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)>1||Math.abs(p.y-h)>.12)throw Error('walker not standing on rendered deck '+JSON.stringify({x,z,h,p}));console.log('[waterfront-walk] '+JSON.stringify({x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,expected:h}));const c={pos:[x+5,h+3,z+6],look:[x,h+1,z],fov:55};a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>c;})()

name: ferry-terminal-check-enabled
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY;const r=C.waterfrontFerries;if(!C.waterfrontFerriesEnabled||!r)throw Error('waterfront ferries disabled');const s=r.stats;const need=[s.terminalBoxes>=3,s.ticketBooths>=3,s.ticketCanopies>=1,s.directoryPanels===3,s.fingerPiers>=2,s.routes.length===3];if(need.some(v=>!v))throw Error('ferry terminal incomplete '+JSON.stringify(need));const ward=r.layout.routes.find(x=>x.id==='ward');if(!C.waterAt(ward.endpoint.x,ward.endpoint.z))throw Error('Ward endpoint not at water');if(C.waterAt(255,684)===false)throw Error('central channel not water');console.log('[ferry-check] '+JSON.stringify({terminalBoxes:s.terminalBoxes,booths:s.ticketBooths,fingers:s.fingerPiers,berths:s.berths,triangles:s.triangles}));})()
